name: Apex
oneLine: Satellite-bus manufacturer; engineering-spec aesthetic of numbered mono nav, hairline grids, and all-caps grotesk.

palette.note: Body background for text-heavy sections (pillars, mission statement)
Pure black product section with the Aries / Nova / Comet bus cards and CTA buttons
Nav index numbers (1.0, 2.0...) and secondary copy; also the grey placeholder behind the unloaded hero video
Single saturated CTA: yellow 'LEARN MORE' button with black mono text
Orbit-tag outlines: purple LEO; siblings #4E98F9 blue and #F76B0E orange Comet tags code product variants

type.note: 300 weight, all caps, 60-72px, near-zero tracking ('THE SPACECRAFT PLATFORM COMPANY'), soft drop shadow on video
16px regular, sentence case, ~1.5 leading, max ~420px per column
12px uppercase, wide tracking, the dominant face (62 nodes): nav, buttons, 'PROUDLY MADE IN AMERICA', orbit tags
ARIES / NOVA / COMET product names in an extended squared display face

layout: Nav is a ruled table: each item a cell divided by 1px grey hairlines, prefixed with a spec index (1.0 PLATFORMS, 2.0 FACTORY) and a '+' glyph.
Split hero: huge headline left 50%, short paragraph + small black CTA top-right; the rest of the viewport is full-bleed factory video.
Three-up columns and product cards bounded by hairline frames with '+' crosshair marks at the corners, like a drawing sheet.
motion: Video-heavy (19 video elements): full-bleed cleanroom footage behind the hero (visible on mobile; desktop captured as flat grey before load).
(inferred) Each bus card plays its own looping render of the spacecraft in the black product grid.
(inferred) Orbit-tag chips (LEO/MEO/GEO) toggle between solid and dashed borders to show available vs unavailable configurations.
interactions: '+' nav items expand into dropdown panels.
Orbit selector chips on each product card (solid = available, dashed = not).
'CONFIGURE NOW' leads to a spacecraft configurator.
steal: Numbered ruled nav (1.0 DATA, 2.0 METHOD, 3.0 RESULTS, 4.0 LIMITS) in mono with hairline cell dividers for our top bar.
Corner '+' crosshair marks on hairline-framed figure panels for every chart on the Results section.
Solid vs dashed outlined chips to show detector states (flagged / not flagged) in the model-comparison table.
leave: Multiple saturated hues (yellow, purple, blue, orange) would break our one-accent rule; keep a single accent.
All-caps light display for long headlines gets hard to read at 3+ lines ('ELIMINATING THE SATELLITE PRODUCTION BOTTLENECK...').
